subject: Urgent: compress SOC 2 evidence window to close deal with Stratify Health
messages:
From: Penelope Rhodes <procurement@stratifyhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com
Cc: Alex Moran <alex.moran@stratifyhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II - final report & interim controls statement request

Karthik,

We're in final procurement review for the platform contract. Legal has requested the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and an interim controls statement for the audit period covering Mar–Apr 2027. We need these to complete our vendor approval by 12 May so we can start onboarding for our pilot.

Is there any chance Redwood can provide the Type II report (or a validated excerpt) plus an interim controls statement / letter confirming no material exceptions for the period above? If you can compress this timeline, it will allow us to proceed with the 6-month pilot budget this quarter.

Attached is our SOC questionnaire high-level checklist — procurement will follow up with any granular asks.

Thanks,
Penelope Rhodes
Head of Procurement
Stratify Health

---

From: karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com
To: marissa_cole@redwoodai.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwoodai.com, soojin_lee@redwoodai.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwoodai.com
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II - final report & interim controls statement request (Stratify) — urgent unblock

Team —

Stratify has a firm procurement cutoff: 12 May. They want the Type II report + an interim controls statement for Mar–Apr. This is a revenue motion we should prioritize; potential $225k ARR first year.

Ask: can security produce a short interim controls statement + point them to the Type II report (or provide an approved excerpt) by EOD Mon 10 May? If full PDF distribution is controlled, we can provide a signed excerpt and the interim statement. Please advise what you need from me to move fast (contacts, redlines, sign-off).

Marissa — flagging for sales lead authorization if we need to offer concession for compressed turnarounds.

Karthik
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com
+1 415-555-0123

---

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodai.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com, soojin_lee@redwoodai.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodai.com, marcus_lin@redwoodai.com
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II - final report & interim controls statement request (Stratify) — urgent unblock

Thanks Karthik —

Short version: yes we can provide an "interim controls statement" (ICS) that summarizes control status for the requested period and call out any open remediation items. We should avoid using the word 'bridge letter' in external comms — use 'interim controls statement' + excerpted report pages.

I need the following immediately:
- Confirmation of which pages of the Type II report Procurement must see (full report vs. excerpt). If they need full PDF we will route through compliance redaction process (24–48h).
- The Stratify contact (Penelope / Alex) to confirm whether notarized signature is required.
- Point people for evidence pulls: soojin will coordinate config logs and access control snapshots; Marcus will gather formal policy docs and evidence of operating effectiveness for Mar–Apr.

If we compress to the 10 May target, we do a focused evidence tranche: policies + 3 control operating-effectiveness samples + signed ICS. Anything beyond that risks incomplete assertions.

Vivek
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

---

From: soojin_lee@redwoodai.com
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodai.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodai.com, marcus_lin@redwoodai.com
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II - final report & interim controls statement request (Stratify) — urgent unblock

Plan and deliverables (compressed 72-hour sprint if we greenlight):
1) Today (Fri 7 May):
   - Vivek to approve ICS template language (I have a draft).
   - Marcus to export policy bundle (InfoSec, Access, Change mgmt).
   - I will snapshot access control lists, GCP/IAM logs, and two representative system traces (generated: 7 May).
2) Mon 10 May EOD:
   - Draft ICS + excerpted Type II pages to Penelope (with redaction notes).
   - Evidence bundle (zipped) available internally via Drive link; external sharing after legal review.
3) If Legal needs notarization/signature, we route to exec sign-off (Marissa) Tues AM.

Dependencies: legal review of ICS wording, and a quick confirmation from Procurement whether partial excerpts are acceptable.

Attachments: SOC2_evidence_checklist.xlsx (working checklist).

Soojin
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

---

From: marissa_cole@redwoodai.com
To: everyone@redwoodai.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 request — sales priority & limited concession approval

Quick note — I'm authorizing the security team to run the compressed evidence sprint and sign the interim controls statement, with the following guardrails:
- We will provide excerpted report pages + ICS; full report distribution only after compliance sign-off.
- If Stratify requires notarization or additional evidence beyond the planned tranche, we will offer a one-time onboarding credit (up to 15% first-year invoice) in exchange for accepting an extended evidence window.
- Any exception to this approach must be routed to me or Revenue Ops.

Karthik — keep Procurement on the tight timeline; I'll join the call if they push back.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com

Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II - final report & interim controls statement request

Penelope / Alex —

Thanks for the quick escalation. We've assembled a focused evidence bundle and a signed interim controls statement draft. Per our compliance playbook, we'll initially share excerpted Type II pages + the interim controls statement (attached) and the supporting evidence bundle internally; external sharing will follow a brief legal redaction check.

If you can confirm that excerpts + ICS are sufficient for Procurement to complete vendor approval by 12 May, we will proceed with external packaging. If you require notarization or the full unredacted report, please let us know immediately (note: that will take an extra 24–48 hours).

Link to internal evidence bundle (for Redwood team): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-stratify-evidence
Attachments: interim_controls_statement_draft.pdf
